holder-quote: I was right all along. Classes are what we make them. A [Clown] might not exist in this world, but we brought a bit of our world with us.
Those are the skills I received on the day when I went crazy. When I had a breakdown and slaughtered a group of Demon soldiers.

effect-quote: Each time he seemed close to death, a body or chance came between him and the blades meant for him.
